name: [Negative] Chart Display Issues
description: Users are unable to view charts or experience frequent crashes when trying to open them, which is affecting their ability to make informed investment decisions.

name: [Critical] Chart Loading Issues
description: Users are unable to load charts or view data due to various issues such as charts not opening, loading slowly, or displaying incorrect data. This leads to frustration and difficulty in trading or making investment decisions.

name: [Critical] Chart Loading Issues
description: Users are facing issues with chart loading, including charts not opening, taking a long time to load, showing a blank screen, failing to update in real-time, and not displaying reliable data. This is observed in both mobile and Android applications, with some users experiencing this issue since the new update.
